items.title: Baidu releases ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base open weights: 280B MoE with 14B active, trained on 33.5T tokens, 128K train / 1M inference context
items.summary: Baidu put ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base on Hugging Face as a pre-training checkpoint (before mid- or post-training): 280B total / 14B active MoE, 43 layers with hybrid HCA+MLA attention, FP8 and BF16 safetensors, and day-0 serving notes for SGLang and vLLM. Baidu's own table puts it ahead of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base, Hy3-preview-Base and MiMo-V2.5-Base on several knowledge, code and long-context base evals (for example MMLU 93.3 and HumanEval+ 82.3). The license Territory excludes the EU, UK and South Korea; commercial use above $50M related revenue needs written authorization; distillation into other models is barred.

doubt.pushback: License bars use in the EU, UK and South Korea; commercial use over $50M related revenue needs Baidu written authorization; no instruction-tuned checkpoint yet (base only).

reception.summary: Builders noted the HF drop and compared it to DeepSeek V4 Flash; several flagged the territory and commercial license limits. About 7 quote posts and tracker amplification read, no Community Note seen.

items.title: OpenAI promotes GPT-Live outbound telephony to GA: voice agents dial out over any SIP trunk with HD Voice and DTMF
items.summary: OpenAI realtime lead Justin Uberti said the GPT-Live outbound telephony API is generally available for all organizations. Developers create a Live session with transport.type sip, dial an E.164 number through a TLS SIP trunk (Twilio, Telnyx and similar), and can send and receive DTMF while the call runs. Docs cover inbound webhooks, outbound create-session, sideband attach, refer/hangup, a 3-minute ring limit and a 2-hour connected-call limit. Grok reported about $0.05 per minute for GPT-Live voice sessions, with SIP provider and backend model costs separate.

reception.summary: Replies welcome SIP+DTMF for real call-center workflows; others ask about answering-machine detection, Asterisk/FreeSWITCH, Europe latency/hosting, GDPR and agent-to-agent negotiation. One builder says Grok Voice 3.0 is cheaper and more practical for cloned voices. About 20 replies and 19 quote posts read.

items.title: Google Antigravity adds a native Jupyter notebook viewer: .ipynb cells, Markdown, tables, images and outputs render in the file viewer
items.summary: Antigravity now opens .ipynb files in its file viewer so code cells, Markdown, tables, images and cell outputs render without leaving the editor. A reply citing the v2.29.0 changelog (Nov 3) says this is a viewer only: no kernel, so cells do not run inside Antigravity yet. Users who tried it with LangChain RAG notebooks called out less context switching; several asked when agents can edit a cell, re-run it and read the new output.

doubt.pushback: Changelog and replies say viewer-only with no kernel; agents cannot yet edit a cell, re-run it and read fresh output.

reception.summary: Positive for notebook-heavy Python workflows; repeated questions about run/edit support and jokes that Antigravity is celebrating opening a file. About 20 replies and 18 quote posts read; one user reported trying a LangChain RAG notebook.
